title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Marine construction is changing shoreline colourscapes. Using coloured settlement panels on seawalls, Holly Cunningham investigates how this changing colourscape is altering benthic communities - and hence how marine constructions may be coloured to reinstate a more naturalistic shoreline ecology. (pp.2858-2869).
